chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: that a man asked him about recitation behind the Imam, so he said:

No. Indeed, the Imam is responsible for the recitation, and the Imam does not guarantee the salat (prayer) of those behind him; rather, he only guarantees the recitation. The second possibility is that what is meant by negating guarantee is the completion of the prayer, because he is not secure from ritual invalidation; that is indicated by this.

key_terms.الضَّمَانِ: the notion of guarantee or responsibility
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْحَدَثِ: a state that invalidates ritual purity and may disrupt prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: the ritual prayer performed by the followers
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: responsible for or bearing liability for

ai.seo_question: Does the Imam guarantee the entire prayer of those praying behind him, or only the recitation?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling of recitation behind the Imam in congregational salat (prayer). It distinguishes between the Imam’s responsibility for recitation and the fact that he does not guarantee the entire prayer of the followers, especially since an invalidating occurrence may happen.
